translation: Floating is qi, rough is wind, rapid (ji) is cramping of the sinews and taxation. When the front region is as if internal, it is the foot Absolute Yin Liver; when it moves it causes lower abdominal pain drawing to the lower back, unfavorable defecation, in men pain within the penis, difficult urination, and hernia with the two testicles ascending into [the abdomen]. In women, unfavorable menstruation, cold within the genitals, closure of the uterus, and urgency of the lower abdomen.
